verdict.rationale: Lovable's built-in Cloud backend explicitly includes edge/serverless functions, database, and auth (lovable-docs-27, lovable-docs-31), and the platform generates backend code from chat (lovable-docs-1, lovable-docs-32), supporting server-side logic. However, there is no direct documentation of built-in third-party integration connectors for payments (e.g., Stripe) or email/transactional-email providers — the only 'integrations' mentioned are Git sync and MCP/agent connectors, not payment/email services. missing for 10: explicit payments (e.g., Stripe) integration docs, explicit email/transactional-email integration docs, and independent hands-on confirmation that these third-party integrations work in practice.
